title: Brain Plastic Rose About Half In Eight Years
hook: Plastic in human brain tissue rose about half in eight years.
closing: Plastic is entering the body, and its health links make exposure worth reducing now.
question: Does this change how you use plastic?

segments.say: Plastic in human brain tissue jumped about half in eight years, showing exposure is getting inside quickly.
Plastic appeared in every placenta tested and most donors' blood, so it is not staying outside us.
Plastic in artery plaque tracked with over four times the risk of heart attack, stroke, or death—a link, not proven cause.
